title: MemoryVLN: From Ego-Aware Memory Representation to Cross-Context Memory Reuse in Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.18478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have shown strong potential for embodied vision-language navigation (VLN), yet their performance degrades on long-horizon trajectories due to context-length limits, redundant historical observations, and unstable spatial alignment across time. These issues make it difficult to both compress long navigation histories and reliably reuse past spatial experience. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MemoryVLN}, a unified memory-driven navigation system built around memory construction and management. translated_title: MemoryVLN：从自我感知记忆表示到视觉语言导航中的跨上下文记忆复用
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在具身视觉语言导航（VLN）领域展现出强大潜力，但由于上下文长度限制、冗余的历史观测以及跨时间空间对齐的不稳定性，其性能在长时程轨迹上会有所下降。这些问题使得压缩长导航历史和可靠地复用过去的空间经验都变得困难。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了MemoryVLN，一个围绕记忆构建与管理构建的统一记忆驱动导航系统。在记忆构建阶段，长序列压缩采用受遗忘曲线启发的时序采样方法，在有限的令牌预算下保留密集的近期证据和稀疏但具有代表性的远期观测。自我感知记忆表示进一步整合了2D语义令牌、3D几何令牌和6D智能体位姿，使每个记忆能够同时编码所观测到的……
tldr: 提出MemoryVLN记忆驱动导航系统，通过受遗忘曲线启发的长序列压缩和融合2D语义令牌、3D几何令牌与6D位姿的自我感知记忆表示，解决了长时程导航中的历史压缩与跨上下文空间经验复用难题。
en_tdlr: MemoryVLN is a unified memory-driven navigation system that addresses long-horizon VLN challenges through forgetting-curve-inspired long sequence compression and ego-aware memory representation integrating 2D semantic tokens, 3D geometric tokens, and 6D agent poses for reliable cross-context memory reuse.
